h.$description: A window's footer bar (View footer): one line of status in --text-faint, the same top line as the toolbar's (--window-edge).

radius.$description: Windows (window.tsx) and sheets (Dialog): rounded corners and crisp whole-pixel outlines, the selected one in the highlight with a soft glow, and an elevation shadow. An app maps these to its own settings (cmd: the ui.window* settings, look.ts): --window-radius, --window-outline, --window-edge-mix (the outline's contrast), --window-elevation, --focus-outline, --focus-glow (1 = the default halo). What's built from them is declared again on .ui-window, where an app's per-mode values resolve.

edge.$description: The outline and the line under the title bar: one opaque colour (the separator over the title bar), so both look the same over any background.

dim.$description: How much this theme darkens unfocused windows: a factor on the ui.unfocusedDim setting.

h.$description: The window toolbar (WindowToolbar), with its 1px line. A row that holds controls is a toolbar, not part of the body.

radius.$description: Sheets look like windows: their corners, outline and the same shadow, higher (4× the windows' elevation, at most 6).
